P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990.

My **2026-10-14** update incorrectly increased prices for **22 fixed-price contract products**, P-1201–P-1222. Eight subsequent orders, SO-77310–SO-77317, show total overcharges of **4,128.60**.

No prices were changed during today’s query.
